messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — metering-heartbeat anomaly detected in eu-west-1. Token counts ~+18% vs expected over the last 15m. Several customers auto-flagged for overage. Paging oncall and billing. thread: 1758204512

sam-ops: Acknowledged. Jumping in and pulling quick diffs.

sam-ops: Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT window_start, sum(tokens_emitted) as tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND window_start >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY window_start
ORDER BY window_start DESC
```
shows a sharp bump starting ~15m ago.

liam-eng: Seeing emitter retry_rate spike on proxy pods (x2). Suspect duplicate emission on retry path — consumer acks may not be making it back. Checking emitter logs now.

jena-ml: Correlation: lots of repeated request_ids in aggregator logs (same req_id, different commit offsets). Could be double-ack + emitter replay.

Priya-SRE: Oncall handoff — I'm taking lead. Triage checklist: 1) switch emitter to single-ack fallback 2) pause any active backfills 3) request billing to mute overage emails for affected window. Doing step 1 now.

billing-squad: We can mute alerts. Tell us the affected window and account list, we'll suppress notifications and hold billing until recon.

support-amy: Noted. I've created INC-4521 and posted a brief customer-facing note to queued tickets for customers who reached out.

liam-eng: Toggled emitter fallback via infra API: `curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/emitter/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"mode":"single_ack"}'` -> 200 OK. Observability shows retry_rate starting to drop.

sam-ops: After toggle quick-check: drift reduced to ~+3% in the last 5m. Running pause for backfills: `./meteringctl pause-backfill --reason 'dup-retry'`

billing-squad: Suppressing overage notifications for window 1758201000 -> 1758204600 and queuing these accounts for manual reconciliation tomorrow morning. Will add tags: `incident:1758204512`.

support-amy: Customer messaging updated: short note saying we detected transient metering noise, suppressing auto-overages, working on reconciliation. Link to support ticket in incident log.

Priya-SRE: Plan: keep single-ack fallback for 30m, gather emitter+proxy logs and aggregator traces, implement dedupe at ingest if we find replay path. If drift stays <5% for 30m we resolve pager and open a follow-up RCA. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident update posted to #incidents-log with link to logs and ticket INC-4521. If anyone sees regression, reply here and we re-escalate.
